Name: TractorMod Expanded
Author: Appendriel1
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[code]TractorMod Expanded turns the tractor into a real farm machine: on its own it only drives, and it does its work through implements you buy, upgrade and attach. Plow, seed, water, break rocks, cut wood, harvest and mow, each with its own implement, sprite, animation and rules.


Based on Tractor Mod by Pathoschild. It replaces Tractor Mod, and your tractor and garage keep working.[/code]
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[code]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods (you should get Mods/TractorModExpanded).
3. Remove or disable Tractor Mod (Mods/TractorMod). The two can't run together.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.[/code]
[b]Main features[/b]
[code]- The tractor does nothing on its own: buy implements at Robin's and attach them. The tool in your hand doesn't work while riding.
- 14 implements:
  - Plow (rear): tills soil, clears weeds, digs artifact spots.
  - Seeder (rear): fertilizes, then plants from a 9-slot hopper (crop seeds, including mod seeds, and fertilizers).
  - Water tank, 3 levels (rear): waters 200 / 400 / 800 tiles. Refill it by facing water and right-clicking (5 seconds). The tank visibly empties.
  - Rock breaker, 2 levels (front): stones and ore; the heavy level also breaks boulders and meteorites.
  - Wood cutter, 2 levels (front): wild trees at every growth stage, stumps and twigs; never fruit trees or tapped trees. The heavy level also breaks large stumps and hollow logs.
  - Produce, grain, bush and fruit tree harvesters (front).
  - Mower (rear): weeds, grass and green rain bushes.
- Blueprint hitch menu: press I while riding, then click or drag an implement onto the tractor.
- Upgrades at Clint, in his "Upgrade tools" menu.
- You never lose an implement: whenever you leave the tractor (dismount, warp, cutscene, passing out, sending it home), the implement goes back to your inventory, or to the ground if it's full.
- New art: a compact tractor in 3 colours (green, red, blue), a modernized garage, implement sprites for every direction and level, inventory icons, work effects and working animations.
- All prices, materials and options can be changed in config.json or in Generic Mod Config Menu.
- English and Portuguese.[/code]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[code]Required:
- SMAPI 4.1.10 or later
- Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later


Optional:
- Generic Mod Config Menu: change the settings in game (tractor colour, effects, speed...).
- Item Extensions: its custom seeds and resources work with the tractor.
- Compact Searchable Shop Menu: implements get their own tab in Robin's shop.


Remove Tractor Mod by Pathoschild before installing.
Tested on Windows in single player. Multiplayer and split-screen haven't been tested yet; in multiplayer every player needs the mod.
Source code: https://github.com/appendriel/TractorModExpanded[/code]
[b]Shout outs[/b]
[code]Huge thanks to Pathoschild, creator of Tractor Mod and SMAPI. This mod is built on Tractor Mod 4.24.4 (MIT License) and keeps its tractor, garage, summoning, tool attachments, audio and config menu. Thanks also to PhthaloBlue, who made Tractor Mod before version 4.0.
Original mod: https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/TractorMod
My mod: https://github.com/appendriel/TractorModExpanded[/code]
